items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So you told once, on the machine running, how Armstrong got his first horn on the boat. Was it Ori and Hadden?

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And so the people have the Stratford Steamer line, they'd buy, if you were working for them, they'd buy you any instrument you wanted. And they'd save you that cash discount and you'd pay them by the week.
So you told once, on the machine running, how Armstrong got his first horn on the boat. Was it Ori and Hadden?
Yeah, Ori had stood for a horn for him. And he went through paying for it. And when he told Ori he was going on the boat, Ori told him if you go on the boat I'm going
